actualPromptText:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production bitmap animation source sheet for enemy-027-reef-stalker, Aliens: Tantalus Frontier.
Reference role: the most recent image is the existing project-local V56 Reef Stalker action sheet, used only as a visual identity and material reference. Preserve its eyeless biomechanical xenomorph character, low quadruped proportions, long dome and black-blue wet carapace. Do NOT copy its4x4 layout, frames, transparent/black presentation, or exact old poses. This V66 sheet must be newly authored in the4x2 contract.
Identity lock: original project adaptation called Reef Stalker, never claimed as an official published creature. A streamlined amphibious XX121-derived xenomorph, extremely low quadruped stance, smooth elongated eyeless dome, narrow inner-jaw mouth, exposed biomechanical rib cage, exactly TWO long forelimbs and TWO digitigrade hind limbs with distinct clawed fingers/toes, long propulsive segmented tail ending in a contained vertical blade-like swimming fin. Three or four LOW flattened dorsal fin-plates sweep backward close to spine; not tall spikes. Black/very dark blue-green glossy wet carapace, cold teal edge iridescence and only tiny restrained salt/algae flecks. Same skull, four limbs, ribs, fin count, tail and palette in all clips.
Do not redesign: no eyes, fish face, shark snout, giant gills, scales, mermaid torso, tentacles, generic marine reptile, crocodile, weapon, armor, clothing, neon sacs, tall warrior tubes, extra arms/legs, limb-fins, split/forked fish tail, scenery or another creature.
Layout: ONE exact2:1 landscape bitmap, invisible FOUR columns by TWO rows, exactly EIGHT distinct chronological full-body poses in strict row-major order. One complete creature per equal square cell. Strict orthographic gameplay SIDE VIEW facing RIGHT in every pose, never turn toward camera or face left. Identical physical skull/body/tail scale. Pelvis centered horizontally; stable ground line at78% of cell height. Whole nose, dorsal plates, four feet and full tail blade inside each own cell with at least10% blank margin on every side; no overlap or fragment crossing. Creature including tail occupies about72% cell width and35% cell height in neutral pose, never enlarge low poses separately.
Style: crisp production-grade2D game sprite with detailed painted/pixel-art-compatible edges, readable black-blue-green wet biomechanical materials and anatomy, controlled neutral cold illumination, no blur, interpolation, duplicate, smear, motion trail or perspective change.
Background: perfectly uniform pure #FF00FF opaque magenta in every empty pixel and limb gap. No cast shadow, floor, gradient, reflection, mist, water, checkerboard, alpha-grid, text, title, numbers, labels, UI, logo, grid lines or watermark. Magenta must not tint body highlights.

Animation IDLE loop: eight individually authored grounded poses showing minimal amphibious alert respiration.1 neutral crouch on all four feet;2 ribs expand slightly;3 head lowers2%;4 tail blade makes a small upward corrective flex while tail stays complete;5 ribs compress;6 head returns;7 dorsal plates settle subtly;8 returns almost to1 without duplicating pixels. All four feet remain planted; no walking, pounce, turn or translation.
note: Built-in ImageGen with inspected local V56 project identity reference shown in conversation due local path ACL helper failure. Original project adaptation; candidate only, no 1:1/canon/runtime/acceptance claim.
